documents.text: Hilario Davide III Hilario Perez Davide III (born August 25, 1964) is a Filipino politician and lawyer who is the current Governor of Cebu. He is the son of former Chief Justice, Hilario Davide Jr. Born in Cebu City on August 25, 1964 to former Supreme Court Chief Justice Hilario Davide Jr. and Virginia J. Perez-Davide, both public servants. Hilario "Junjun" Davide III is married to Jobella G. Angan and has three daughters: Patricia Janelli, Dana Giannina, and Niña Francesca.
